youtube_title: The Smoke Alarm Is Not The Bad Guy This Thanksgiving | Funny Cartoon
description:
Dad is cooking the whole Thanksgiving dinner by himself this year, and the smoke alarm is having the worst day of his life. Everyone blames the alarm. But Grandma has a secret she has kept for fifty years.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving
tiktok_caption: pov: you're the villain but you're the smoke alarm 🦃 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving

lines.text: Hello. I am the smoke alarm. Everyone in this house thinks I am the bad guy.
Today is Thanksgiving. Today they will hate me the most.
Okay team. Dad is cooking the whole dinner this year. No help.
Dad, you burned cereal last week.
He has never cooked a turkey in his life. I am already nervous.
Step one. A whole stick of butter in a very hot pan. Flavor smoke!
Beep. Beep. Beep.
No! Not now! I'm in the zone!
Grab a towel! Wave it! Wave it at the ceiling!
Please stop waving the towel at me. I am not a bull. I am a safety device.
Why are you so loud? Can't you just send a text?
I did send a text. It was the smoke.
Step two. Rolls. Grandma's famous rolls. Ten minutes.
He forgot the timer. He went to watch the big game.
Dad! The rolls!
Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep.
That's it. I'm taking your battery out.
You cannot reach me. I am on a very tall ceiling.
I have a broom.
Dad, if you take the battery out, we forget to put it back. Like last year.
Thank you. Also, the rolls are now hockey pucks.
Hello, family! Why does the house smell like a campfire?
Mom, it's under control. The alarm is just being dramatic.
That alarm has been dramatic since nineteen ninety eight.
I was installed in two thousand twelve. Ma'am, I have a sticker.
Every year your father cooked, that thing went off. Every single year.
Every year, someone gets mad at me. Nobody ever gets mad at the butter.
The family group chat calls him the villain. His name in there is Beep Face.
Hurtful. Accurate. But hurtful.
Step three. The gravy. Mom, step back. I have a video.
Of course, dear. I'll just make some toast. For the stuffing.
Wait. Why is Grandma holding toast so close to the toaster's highest setting?
Beep. Beep. Beep.
Oh no. Carl, go open every window in the house. Take your time. All of them.
Ma'am. I saw that. You burned that toast on purpose.
Shh. Every year I burn one slice. The men run off to open windows.
And while they're gone, I fix the gravy. Fifty years. Nobody knows.
Grandma! You are the villain!
Twelve years I took the blame. Twelve years of towels in my face.
And twelve years of perfect gravy. You're welcome, Beep Face.
All the windows are open! Wow, the gravy looks amazing. I'm a natural!
Should I tell him?
Tell him and I'll find that broom.
Everyone, a toast! To family. And to the smoke alarm, for keeping us safe.
Thank you. Finally, some respect.
Happy Thanksgiving. Also, my battery is low. I will tell you about it at three a.m.
